headline: Approved eight sign applications, including one with conditions, all by 4-0 votes
summary: The committee reviewed and approved sign applications for eight businesses, including A Street Frames, Beacon Bank, The Toyary, Trinity Naturals, Dunkin, Opus Insurance, Socceroof & Padel, and X-Step Fitness. One approval, for A Street Frames, included a condition that new sign renderings be submitted to Inspection services via email. The committee also discussed compliance updates on sign violations at 671 Salem St, 730 Eastern Ave, and 269-271 Main St.
decisions: Approved the sign application from A Street Frames at 730A Eastern Ave, with conditions that new sign renderings be submitted to Inspection services via email for approval, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from Beacon Bank at 196 Commercial St, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from The Toyary at 730 Eastern Ave, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from Trinity Naturals at 36 Charles St, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from Dunkin at 649 Salem St, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from Opus Insurance at 221 Sylvan St, 4-0.
Approved the temporary banner for Socceroof & Padel at 735 Broadway for 1 year, 4-0.
Approved the sign application from X-Step Fitness at 258 Highland Ave, 4-0.

CITY OF MALDEN
MASSACHUSETTS
Sign Design Review Committee
Meeting Minutes
Date: February 12, 2026
        Time: 9:00 AM
Members in Attendance :
Nelson Miller Jadeane Sica
Ari Taylor Alex Pratt
Members not in Attendance:
Yem Lip
Also in Attendance:
Gia Finocchiaro Dave Mores
Jim Tuxbury
Meeting Called to Order:  9:05AM
Called to Order By: Jadeane Sica
Seconded By: Nelson Miller
Approval of Minutes
 From: January 8, 2026
Approved By: Ari Taylor
Seconded By: Alex Pratt
Updates from Compliance:
671 Salem St- UPSCALE ACCOUNTING FIRM - They installed window signs 
under the cover of darkness st 9:30pm. Pictures taken; installer was advised that 
they did not have a permit and/or approval for the window signs that completely 
covered all glass areas. He claimed he did not speak English. We spoke with the 
business owner that following morning about the violations. Window signs have 
since been downsized and they have since applied for a permit. Application was 
returned incomplete; they are working with Gia to correct.
730 Eastern Ave- TOYARY - They installed signs without a permit and/or 
approval. They have applied and are on the agenda today.
269-271 Main St- THE BREAKFAST CLUB - Have gone out of business. 
Sign/Banner is still on the building. Spoke with the property owner and advised 
him of the violation. Signs are still up; tickets have been issued.
The following designs were considered for approval:
1. The Committee reviewed a sign application from A Street Frames located 
at 730A Eastern Ave. Scott Weaver & Jeffrey Cadey business owners 
were present. The Committee voted to approve the sign with conditions 
that new sign renderings be submitted to Inspection services via email for 
approval. Motion was made by Ari Taylor , Seconded by Nelson Miller
4 Yea 0 Nay
2. The Committee reviewed a sign application from Beacon Bank located at 
196 Commercial St. Heather Dudko from Sousa Sings LLC was present. 
The Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion made by Alex Pratt. 
Seconded by Ari Taylor
4 Yea 0 Nay
3. The Committee reviewed a sign application from The Toyary located at 
730 Eastern Ave. Sara Altukhaim business owner was present The 
Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion made by Ari Taylor.
Seconded by Alex Pratt.
4 Yea 0 Nay
4. The Committee reviewed a sign application from Trinity Naturals located at
36 Charles St. Charles Glyman from Foster, Walker & Dimarco 
representing the business was present. The Committee voted to approve 
the sign. Motion made by Ari Taylor Seconded by Alex Pratt
4 Yea 0 Nay
5. The Committee reviewed a sign application from Dunkin located at 649 
Salem St. Jason Parillo Viewpoint Sign & Awning was present. The 
Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion made by Ari Taylor. 
Seconded by Alex Pratt
4 Yea 0 Nay
6. The Committee Reviewed a sign application from Opus Insurance located 
at 221 Sylvan St. Dell Costa business owner was present. The Committee 
voted to approve the sign. Motion made by Ari Taylor. Seconded by Alex 
Pratt
4 Yea 0 Nay
7. The Committee reviewed a sign application from Socceroof & Padel
located at 735 Broadway. A company representative was present. The 
Committee voted to approve the temporary banner for 1 year. Motion was 
made by Ari Taylor seconded by Alex Pratt
4 Yea 0 Nay
8. The Committee reviewed a sign application from X-Step Fitness located at
258 Highland Ave. Henry Tan Business owner was present. The 
Committee voted to approve the sign. Motion made by Alex Pratt. 
Seconded by Ari Taylor
4 Yea 0 Nay
Meeting adjourned at :
Time: 9:56 AM
By: Jadeane Sica
Motion By: Ari Taylor
Seconded By: Alex Pratt
Minutes respectfully submitted by : Gia Finocchiaro
